shortDescription: TORONTO, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Constellation Software Inc. The Company’s quarterly results will be disseminated via press release, and made available on the Company’s website (www.csisoftware.com) and SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca), after the Toronto Stock Exchange closes on Friday, November 6, 2026. Mark Miller, President, Jamal Baksh, Chief Financial Officer, and Bernard Anzarouth, Chief Investment Officer will be available during the November 9, 2026 conference call to answer questions regarding the Company’s results.

To access the call, please dial 1-877-879-1183 (North America toll free) or 1-412-902-6703 (International) and using conference ID 2676476. A conference operator will create a queue and introduce each questioner. You can also hear the call using the link https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/mwixrbs6 A replay of the call can be accessed using https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/mwixrbs6 for 12 months following the call.
Constellation Software acquires, manages and builds vertical market software businesses.

title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Conference Call to Discuss Third Quarter Results
